title: Four witnesses named by SIU: [Ontario Edition]
article: The province's Special Investigations Unit has designated four Toronto police officers as witnesses to the death of Nicholas Blentzas, who collapsed and died June 23 after being pepper-sprayed by police.
That brings to nine the number of officers involved in the incident in which Blentzas died after a confrontation with police outside his Thorncliffe Park Dr. apartment building.
Five officers, all working out of 53 Division, have already been designated as subject officers by the SIU, a civilian agency that investigates deaths or serious injuries involving police.
The four officers designated as witnesses are required to tell SIU investigators what they saw that night.
SIU spokesperson Rose Hong said toxicology tests must be completed before a full picture emerges of the reasons for Blentzas' sudden collapse and death.
The agency hasn't released the autopsy results, nor the names of the subject officers.
